description: Lists the versions of the music that played, newest first, one per row: "#id — time (UTC) — origin — \"label\" — first line of code". Ids never change. Rows without "#" mark where a Claude session started. The newest version row is usually what plays now; "the previous version" is the next version row down, "3 changes ago" is three version rows below the newest. Pass limit to see more than 20. Pass filter to find a version by a word from its label, code or favorite name; pass favorites: true to list favorites.

filter.description: Only versions whose label, code or favorite name contains this text (case-insensitive)

limit.description: How many versions to list, newest first (default 20)

name: list_history
